verdict.rationale: skills.sh does not need an export step because installed skills already live as local files in an open format. Skills are SKILL.md files (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown) stored in project or user directories that can be committed with the project, and the lock file is skills-lock.json. Skills are reusable across 70+ agents, the CLI runs with no account, and a `remove` command supports leaving cleanly. missing for 10: an explicit documented export/data-portability feature, a statement about export of any server-side or leaderboard data tied to the user, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.
